claim: Experiment 5's investigation, unchanged, on three further model families (Pythia-160m, OPT-125m, Qwen2.5-0.5B) blamed every large true effect (3/3, 3/3, 4/4), none of the 36 exactly-zero effects, and re-scored deterministically.
integrity_note: Integrity is not truth: a verifying manifest shows these files are unchanged since packaging; it does not show the experiment or the claim is correct.
scope: Pre-registered (protocol 74f1958). Ground truth computed exactly from each model's deterministic margins. Large effects were mostly near-deterministic. Detection limit at 30 runs per configuration: true effects of about 0.41 and above detected, about 0.16 and below missed. Small local open-weights models only, no hosted providers, two-option sampling, factors chosen by the author. Traces are regenerable and not included. Single author.
